mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_content_import_record (content_id, file_name, content_type, file_size, status, error_message, index_task_id, completed_at) VALUES (#{contentId}, #{fileName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{indexTaskId}, #{completedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, content_id, file_name, content_type, file_size, status, error_message, index_task_id, created_at, completed_at FROM training_content_import_record WHERE id = #{recordId}
mapper.update: UPDATE training_content_import_record SET content_id = #{contentId}, status = 'SUCCEEDED', error_message = NULL, index_task_id = #{indexTaskId}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{recordId}
UPDATE training_content_import_record SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{recordId}
